name: kintone_apps_search
title: アプリ検索
description: Search kintone apps the authenticated user can see (GET /k/v1/apps.json). Filter by ids, codes, name (partial match) or space_ids; returns one page (use offset for the next). Returns the raw kintone response: {apps:[{appId, code, name, ...}]}. Always reads the latest data (no cache).

codes.description: App codes to match exactly (case-sensitive; 1-64 characters each, up to 100).

name.description: App name partial match (case-insensitive, up to 64 characters).

space_ids.description: Space IDs the apps belong to (up to 100).

limit.description: Number of apps to return (1-100). Default 100.

offset.description: Number of apps to skip (0 or greater). Default 0. Call again with offset to get the next page.

max_response_tokens.description: Safety limit on the estimated response size in tokens (default: 50000, 0 disables). If exceeded, the call fails with response_too_large instead of returning a truncated result.

name: kintone_app_describe
title: アプリ定義の取得
description: Describe a kintone app: its basic info and its field definitions (GET /k/v1/app.json + GET /k/v1/app/form/fields.json). Specify the app with exactly one of app (ID) or app_ref (ID, code or name). Returns {app:{app_id, code, name, description, space_id?, ...}, fields:{<field code>:{...raw kintone definition}}, revision?}. Always reads the latest data (never uses the cache) and refreshes the field cache used by name resolution.

app.description: kintone app ID (positive integer). Specify exactly one of app or app_ref (either one, not both).

app_ref.description: App reference: app ID, app code, or app name (exact match first, then partial match when it is unique). Specify exactly one of app or app_ref (either one, not both).

lang.description: Display language of the field labels: ja, en, zh, user or default.

max_response_tokens.description: Safety limit on the estimated response size in tokens (default: 50000, 0 disables). If exceeded, the call fails with response_too_large instead of returning a truncated result.

name: kintone_records_query
title: レコード検索
description: Query records of a kintone app (GET /k/v1/records.json). Specify the app with exactly one of app (ID) or app_ref (ID, code or name). Returns {records:[...raw kintone records], total_count?:number}. One request per call, no automatic paging: put limit/offset in query to fetch more. Large results fail with response_too_large; narrow with fields, a smaller limit or a tighter query.

app.description: kintone app ID (positive integer). Specify exactly one of app or app_ref (either one, not both).

app_ref.description: App reference: app ID, app code, or app name (exact match first, then partial match when it is unique). Specify exactly one of app or app_ref (either one, not both).

query.description: kintone query language, e.g. `status = "Open" order by $id desc limit 50 offset 0`. Put limit (max 500, default 100) and offset (max 10,000) in the query.

fields.description: Field codes to return (up to 100). Omit to return all fields.

total_count.description: true to also return total_count (number of records matching the query).

max_response_tokens.description: Safety limit on the estimated response size in tokens (default: 50000, 0 disables). If exceeded, the call fails with response_too_large instead of returning a truncated result.

name: kintone_record_create
title: レコード作成
description: Create records in a kintone app (POST /k/v1/records.json). Specify the app with exactly one of app (ID) or app_ref (ID, code or name). For writes app_ref must match the app ID, code or name EXACTLY: a partial name match is never used; when only partial matches exist the call fails with resolver_app_exact_match_required and details.candidates, so call again with app set to a candidate ID. Specify exactly one of record (1 record) or records (1-100 records), each shaped {"<field code>":{"value":...}}; all records are created or none. Returns {ids:[number], revisions:[number]}. A failed write is not retried, and after a timeout or network failure the result is unknown (check before creating again). Without an explicit idempotency key, a call with the same arguments within 5 minutes is treated as a re-send of the earlier call and returns the previous result: the second record is NOT created. To create identical records on purpose, pass a different idempotency_key argument (or _meta.idempotency_key) on each call.

app.description: kintone app ID (positive integer). Specify exactly one of app or app_ref (either one, not both).

app_ref.description: App reference: app ID, app code, or app name. Write operations accept an EXACT match only (a partial name match is never used: it fails with resolver_app_exact_match_required and details.candidates; pass a candidate ID as app). Specify exactly one of app or app_ref (either one, not both).

record.description: One record to create: {"<field code>":{"value":...}}. Specify exactly one of record or records.

records.description: Records to create (1-100), each {"<field code>":{"value":...}}. Specify exactly one of record or records.

name: kintone_record_update
title: レコード更新
description: Update one record of a kintone app (PUT /k/v1/record.json). Specify the app with exactly one of app (ID) or app_ref (ID, code or name). For writes app_ref must match the app ID, code or name EXACTLY: a partial name match is never used; when only partial matches exist the call fails with resolver_app_exact_match_required and details.candidates, so call again with app set to a candidate ID. Identify the record with id, or with update_key_field / update_key_field_ref + update_key_value (update_key_field_ref also accepts only an EXACT field code or label; a partial label match fails with resolver_field_exact_match_required and details.candidates). record (required, not empty) holds the fields to update as {"<field code>":{"value":...}}; revision enables optimistic locking. Returns {revision:number}. A failed write is not retried.

app.description: kintone app ID (positive integer). Specify exactly one of app or app_ref (either one, not both).

app_ref.description: App reference: app ID, app code, or app name. Write operations accept an EXACT match only (a partial name match is never used: it fails with resolver_app_exact_match_required and details.candidates; pass a candidate ID as app). Specify exactly one of app or app_ref (either one, not both).

id.description: ID of the record to update. Specify either id or update_key_field(_ref) + update_key_value, not both.

update_key_field.description: Field code used as the update key (a text field or number field with 'prohibit duplicate values'). Exclusive with update_key_field_ref and id.

update_key_field_ref.description: Update key field given as field code or label. For writes only an EXACT match is accepted: a partial label match fails with resolver_field_exact_match_required and details.candidates (use the code). Exclusive with update_key_field and id.

update_key_value.description: Value of the update key field that identifies the record.

revision.description: Expected revision of the record for optimistic locking (integer; -1 means no check).

record.description: Fields to update: {"<field code>":{"value":...}}. Required and not empty.

name: kintone_record_delete
title: レコード削除
description: Delete records of a kintone app (DELETE /k/v1/records.json). This cannot be undone. Specify the app with exactly one of app (ID) or app_ref (ID, code or name). For writes app_ref must match the app ID, code or name EXACTLY: a partial name match is never used; when only partial matches exist the call fails with resolver_app_exact_match_required and details.candidates, so call again with app set to a candidate ID. ids (1-100) are the record IDs to delete; revisions (optional, same length as ids) enable optimistic locking. All records are deleted or none. Returns {deleted:number}. A failed write is not retried.

app.description: kintone app ID (positive integer). Specify exactly one of app or app_ref (either one, not both).

app_ref.description: App reference: app ID, app code, or app name. Write operations accept an EXACT match only (a partial name match is never used: it fails with resolver_app_exact_match_required and details.candidates; pass a candidate ID as app). Specify exactly one of app or app_ref (either one, not both).

ids.description: IDs of the records to delete (1-100, positive integers). Required.

revisions.description: Expected revisions for optimistic locking, one per id in the same order (-1 means no check). Must have the same length as ids.
